s1.quote: it can have a strong current pushing from the north to the south. … it is only suited to advanced divers because of the strength of the current.

s2.quote: The northern and southern tips of Elphinstone have 100m wide plateaus between 20-40m deep … oceanic white tip sharks, seemingly always accompanied by pilot fish … Stay close to the reef to avoid being swept out to sea if the current is strong.

highlights.text: Oceanic whitetip sharks with pilot fish

hazards.text: Strong current; risk of being swept off the reef

summary.text: An open-ocean reef off Marsa Alam whose southern plateau sits at roughly 20-40 m. Currents can run hard along the walls, so it is a drift dive for advanced divers, famed for oceanic whitetip sharks.

s1.quote: starting from 3 to 33 feet (1 to 10 m) … the outside walls at 131 to 164 feet (40 to 50 m)

s2.quote: you are free to dive on the house reef any time you like … one of the best preserved house reefs in Egypt

access.value: Guests may dive the house reef any time without a guide

summary.text: A well-preserved house reef at Marsa Shagra village on Egypt's Red Sea coast. Coral starts in very shallow water and slopes gradually to outer walls at 40-50 m. Guests can dive it freely.

sites.name: Abu Helal

s1.quote: Depth: 40 - 60 M … Entering from the shore, divers encounter a shallow lagoon at about 7 – 12 metres with compact reefs on either side. … Difficulty: Intermediate … said to reach 30 – 40 metres.

highlights.text: Coral garden and canyon with swim-throughs

sites.depthNote: Lagoon 7-12 m; canyon 40-60 m is technical
